description: Check errors and warnings on a node and its descendants. TouchDesigner reports missing files, dangling operator references and shader compile failures as warnings, so do not treat hasErrors=false as a healthy node. Reads the operator errors and warnings streams only: an exception raised inside a Script OP callback, a scriptCHOP onCook for example, lands on neither and is reported nowhere here, so an empty report is not evidence the node cooked

detailLevel.description: Response detail level for tool output (minimal, summary, or detailed)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to include in formatted output

nodePath.description: Absolute path to the node to inspect. e.g., "/project1/text1"

responseFormat.description: Structured output format for formatted responses

name: get_td_node_errors
